candidates.license_scope: Original CAD model geometry/code only; manufacturer names, logos and product designs retain third-party rights. Keep MIT notice and manufacturer notices. DejaVu Sans licence applies to geometric lettering.

visual_inspection.assessment: Recognizable device-specific CAD geometry with fine enclosure, controls, connectors and markings; colour materials, no photographic/PBR texture maps. A researched approximation, not a manufacturer CAD scan.
visual_inspection.preview_caveat: Publisher preview is a CAD render. Native museum lighting/material appearance still requires visual QA.
